label: Overview
description: A small budget with editable item, category, quantity and price cells and a worked-out total. Best for the smallest working Spreadsheet: data, columns, getRowId, onCellsChange.

label: Clipboard & Fill
description: Copy, cut, paste and clear a block of cells, and drag the fill handle to repeat them, with a live count of what was written. Best for moving data to and from other spreadsheets.

label: Validation & Status Marks
description: Cells that refuse a value they cannot hold and show an invalid mark, with a dirty mark on every unsaved edit. Best for batch editing that is saved in one go.

label: Draft Row
description: An add-row button under the last row that appends an empty line, tinted as new. Best for grids people grow as they type.

label: Formulas & A1 Headers
description: A quote worked out with formulas (SUM, ROUND, cell references), column letters and row numbers, and a bar showing the focused cell's address and formula; fill moves a formula's references. Best for sheets that calculate as people type.
